evidence_class: Static: frozen expected-red C2-C4 control-design review; no Rust, Python, candidate, physical, or target execution by reviewer
resolved_from_controls01: Expected result JSON remains assertion-side; candidate helpers receive retained capture/raw probes only.
Expected assessment keys match retained JSON.
Retained controls assert p0, delta0, p1, Dot2 residuals, delta1, p2, h, Cbar, tau, classifications and final feasibility.
Factor observations require zero added factorizations, exactly two applications and stable factor identity.
Scratch controls include empty hook logs and bit-identical owner/live-state snapshots.

findings.finding: Negative controls still pass an enum selector and only require the refusal to echo that selector. They neither provide a concrete mutated numerical operand nor assert the exact typed numerical refusal, so a branch on the enum can satisfy the test without exercising final-box, scratch-radius, or active-value guards.
findings.required_fix: Construct each violating coordinate/value/bound in test-side typed raw input, call the shared seam, and assert the exact typed reason, no returned step or BVLS-02 fallback, all prohibited hook counters/logs, and unchanged snapshots.

findings.finding: The work equation is true when denied_work is zero and supplies no insufficient cap, exact required charge, entry count, or denial action. It therefore does not prove that denied work is charged before refinement entry.
findings.required_fix: Add a dedicated insufficient-budget raw probe with the exact nonzero K/G reservation requirement, an attempted-entry and denied-entry counter increment before admission, zero executed correction/Dot2/factor arithmetic, an explicit denial result, and restored nested-budget snapshot. Do not record denied planned arithmetic as executed work.

findings.finding: Ineligible controls assert only an action string and do not compare the unchanged BVLS-02 result, masks, or work. There is no refused-corrected-face no-fallback observation. Full p-vector bits establish active values but do not establish that active masks remain unchanged across both correction positions.
findings.required_fix: Observe active masks at p0, p1, p2 and exit; compare each ineligible probe with the unchanged BVLS-02 result/masks/work; and add a corrected-face refusal case with zero fallback calls and no third correction.

residual_risk: The eventual body review must verify that the test adapters only decode fixtures and observe the actual shared controller/refinement implementation; no parallel solver, report framework, fixture-derived candidate values, or selector-short-circuit is acceptable.
missing_evidence: Corrected immutable expected-red control cut addressing all three findings
Parent-owned expected-red compile receipt for that exact cut
Body source review and green receipt after implementation
